item.title: Traffic crash with serious injuries causes major delays on I-195 eastbound before I-495 in Wareham
item.description: WAREHAM – A traffic crash was causing significant delays for motorists headed to Cape Cod via I-195. The collision was shortly after 5 PM Friday eastbound before the I-495 junction. One person reportedly suffered potentially life-threatening injuries. Further details were not immediately available.
